moves.explanation: Opening with the one plan every horror audience is shouting at the screen about. Two flashlights become one each, and nobody watches anybody's back.
Only move that stops the house from getting bigger. Whatever is here now has one way in, and Blue knows where it is.
Hears the house move, then climbs straight toward it alone. The car was the whole plan, and Red resigns the game on the stairs.
moves.bestMove: Walk back to the car with Blue and call it in.
